transcript: The other night, I saw a new comedy at MCC by Douglas Lyons called Table 17 and it was wonderful. It’s a pretty straightforward concept, two exes are seeing each other for the first time in awhile and all sorts of memories come flooding back. I bought a ticket specifically to see Kara Young who has been stellar and everything I've seen her in and this was no exception. All three of the actors in this piece were great, and were able to bring quite a bit of emotional depth to a somewhat corny script. And I mean that in the most unoffensive way, but rather a complimentary one, actually. You know, this play is described as a rom-com and it really delivers on that. The way that it smartly sequences its reveals, and its light breaking of the fourth wall, they had the audience in the palm of their hands the entire time. It was just a really enjoyable piece and a refreshingly simple but well done concept. You should go see it. With that, another program for my collection.
